CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  FEBRUARY 28, 2026

A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Torosis at 9:02 a.m., on
Saturday, February 28, 2026, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street, Santa Monica, CA.

Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Caroline Torosis
  Mayor Pro Tern Jesse Zwick (arrived at 9:05 a.m.)
  Councilmember Lana Negrete (arrived at 9:04 a.m.)
  Councilmember Dan Hall
  Councilmember Ellis Raskin
  Councilmember Barry Snell
  Councilmember Natalya Zemitskaya

  Also Present:  City Manager Oliver Chi
  Interim City Clerk Denise Anderson-Warren

CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 9:02 a.m., with all
  members present except Councilmember Negrete and Mayor Pro Tern
  Zwick. Councilmember Hall led the assemblage in the Pledge of Allegiance.

STATEMENT OF  The City of Santa Monica Statement of Accountability (Land
ACCOUNTABILITY  Acknowledgement) was read into the record by Councilmember Snell.
